crossRefs.note: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
Now, Yahweh God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever…
Lord, according to all your righteousness, let your anger and please let your wrath be turned away from your city…
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

translations.web: Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
translations.bsb: O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea; in Your righteousness, answer me.
translations.kjv: Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
translations.asv: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah; give ear to my supplications: In thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
